metadata.question: Was more than 30 percent of Lake Okeechobee’s surface covered by cyanobacteria on June 12, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Okeechobee is in Florida, USA (approximate center: 27.0°N, 80.8°W) - Date: June 12, 2023 - For cyanobacteria detection, I'll use Sentinel-2 with the Cyanobacteria Index (CI) or NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) - NDCI = (Red Edge - Red) / (Red Edge + Red) = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) - Higher NDCI values (>0.1 or 0.2) typically indicate algal blooms 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get valid water pixels - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 - Focus only on the lake surface (need lake boundary) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid detection: NDCI calculated successfully, pixel count > 0 - If no images found: C1 - If all pixels masked out: C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 - Compare percentage of high NDCI pixels (cyanobacteria) to total water pixels ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Okeechobee geometry (approximate boundary) const lakeCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([-80.8, 27.0]); const lake = lakeCenter.buffer(25000); // ~25km radius to cover the lake // 2. Date range const startDate = '2023-06-11'; const endDate = '2023-06-13'; // 3. Load Sentinel-2 data const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lake) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const imageCount = s2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found for the date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBit = 1 << 10; const cirrusBit = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 5. Calculate NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) function addNDCI(image) { const ndci = image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); return image.addBands(ndci); } // 6. Process imagery const processed = s2.map(maskClouds).map(addNDCI).median(); // 7. Count total valid pixels const totalPixels = processed.select('NDCI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lake, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI'); const totalCount = totalPixels.getInfo(); console.log(`Total valid pixels: ${totalCount}`); if (totalCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Threshold for cyanobacteria detection (NDCI > 0.1 indicates potential algae) const cyanoThreshold = 0.1; const cyanoBacteria = processed.select('NDCI').gt(cyanoThreshold); // 9. Count cyanobacteria pixels const cyanoPixels = cyanoBacteria.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lake, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI'); const cyanoCount = cyanoPixels.getInfo(); if (cyanoCount === null || totalCount === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Calculate percentage const percentage = (cyanoCount / totalCount) * 100; console.log(`Cyanobacteria pixels: ${cyanoCount}`); console.log(`Coverage percentage: ${percentage.toFixed(2)}%`); // 11. Determine answer if (percentage > 30) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
